hight.definition:
n. A variant of Height.
imp. of Hight
p. p. of Hight
v. t. & i. To be called or named.
v. t. & i. To command; to direct; to impel.
v. t. & i. To commit; to intrust.
v. t. & i. To promise.

hightail.definition: v. leave as fast as possible
hightail.translation: vi. 迅速撤退, 迅速逃走

hightailed.definition: v leave as fast as possible
hightailed.translation: v. 拼命逃走, 追赶( hightail的过去式和过去分词 )

hightailing.definition: v leave as fast as possible
hightailing.translation: v. 拼命逃走, 追赶( hightail的现在分词 )

hightails.definition: v leave as fast as possible
hightails.translation: v. 拼命逃走, 追赶( hightail的第三人称单数 )

highton.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 海顿住所名称，来源于古英语，含义是“高+圈用地，居留地”(high+enclosure,settlement)
